stage1.impression: A square-on, symmetrical, low-res frame of a timber record wall with two smoked glass boxes and two pendants either side of two record players. It reads as a clean CG render, not a photograph: the timber is smeared and uniform, and the empty, cool-lit concrete cubbies in the centre look unfinished. Two saturated electric-blue bands under the decks look like LED strip or nightclub signage and pull the eye from the speakers, which are grey and veiled behind their pendants. A magazine would not run it as a specific place. It reads as a generic hotel-lobby bar or a showroom: no sign of life on the counter, no chairs and no foot rail in frame, and the speakers do not read as the altar.

blocking_9: The speakers read at a glance as the hero: horn and cabinet tint legible, niche lum_median >= 50 with visible separation from the felt behind, not hidden behind the Dome pendants
No cool or blue light anywhere in the room's surfaces: the centre record wall and the niche head strips warm (r_median > b_median)
The centre of the record wall is filled (records and the frosted disc glowing warm), not empty concrete cubbies
Signs of life in frame: glasses, a candle, the coat over a counter chair, the brass foot rail and chair backs visible
A composition that is not dead-centre and frontal: a seated, slightly off-axis view across the zinc so that the counter has depth
The fluted oak front reads as dark oak, not salmon or pink, and is not the brightest large surface in the frame
Full-resolution render with the timber grain, concrete board marks and steel patina resolving at 1:1, without denoiser smear

defects.what: Saturated blue bands under the left record player read as LED strip or signage; the only saturated colour in the frame is not the speaker
Same blue bands under the right record player
Centre record wall: empty cubbies with flat, cool, blue-grey concrete backs (b_median 81 > r 79); no records, and no warm disc visible; reads as an unfinished set
Cool blue strip at the head of the left niche (b 87 vs r 65), inconsistent with the 2400-2900 K practicals
Cool blue strip at the head of the right niche (b 91 vs r 70)
Left speaker veiled and grey (lum_median 39, below 45); the horn reads as a dull disc behind the glass, and the Dome pendant sits in front of it and hides the cabinet's top
Right speaker darker still (lum_median 35, lum_range 29 in its body); flat and low contrast
Fluted counter front is pink-salmon (r 94, g 62, b 50) and is the brightest large surface (median 68), brighter than the speakers; the flutes repeat uniformly, which reads as CG
Zinc top bare: no glasses, candles or coat visible, apart from a white menu card and a blank white placard (the placard at 590-630 reads as a price tag)
Top band crushed toward black with smeared record spines (median 15.5)
Denoiser smear and soft, waxy timber everywhere at 1:1; the shelf grain is one repeated texture

changes.problem: The speakers, the reason for the frame, are grey, veiled and darker than the counter front.

evidence.measured: left niche lum_median 39.1, right 35.1 (target >= 45); body lum_range 29 to 38; counter front median 67.6

change.setting: lamps: on each Ember speaker 4 x area (W/m2 at the target), plus the lit niche's strip
change.to: 3.0 W/m2 grazing from above and side to rim the cabinet edges and horn mouth, 2700 K; strip 4.0 and warmed (see c3)

changes.expected: Cabinet edges and horn lip pick up glowing polished-edge highlights; the niches become the brightest non-lamp areas after the bar top.

changes.problem: The camera is square-on and centred at 1.35 m, so the frame is a flat elevation: the pendants overlap the speakers, and the counter, the chairs and the foot rail have no depth.

evidence.measured: perfect bilateral symmetry; the Domes at 100-170 x 110-160 sit over the speaker tops; no chairs or rail in frame

change.to: about [5.6, 2.9, 1.15] (seated, about 1.3 m off-axis toward the shopfront) looking at [7.3, 6.0, 1.3], 35 mm, f/2.8 focused on the nearer speaker's horn, so that a chair back and the brass rail cut the lower left foreground

changes.expected: The near speaker reads large and three-quarter, clear of its Dome; the zinc recedes in perspective and the chairs and rail give scale and life.

changes.problem: Cool, bluish light on the centre record wall and in the niche head strips breaks the warm practicals and adds a second colour.

evidence.measured: r 79 / g 77 / b 81; niche strips b 87-91 vs r 65-70

change.setting: the disc behind the DJ station / the lit niche's strip colour / the record wall's spots
change.from: disc 0.06 #FFD2A0 with 2.0 W area lamp; record wall spots 30 W 2600 K
change.to: disc 0.5 #FFD2A0 with 15 W area lamp so that it reads as a soft frosted glow; niche strips set to 2700 K; record wall spots 45 W 2600 K aimed at the spines, not the backs

changes.expected: The centre reads as a warm frosted glow framed by records; no surface has b_median above r_median.

changes.problem: The centre of the record wall is empty cubbies, so it reads as an unfinished set, not a listening bar's library.

evidence.measured: seen at 3x: nine bare concrete-backed cubbies, no spines

change.to: fill every cubby around the disc with spines of varied height and lean, a few sleeves face-out, a couple of gaps; keep the disc's opening clear

changes.expected: The wall reads as dense and lived-in, with small highlights on the spines.

changes.problem: The fluted oak front is salmon-pink and the brightest large surface, which competes with the speakers and reads as laminate.

change.setting: the oak's stain / the Domes' downlights' aim
change.from: light warm stain; downlights spilling onto the front
change.to: dark smoked-oak stain (base about #3A2A20, satin), with slight per-flute grain and tone variation; aim the Dome downlights to land on the zinc, not over its edge

changes.expected: The counter front falls to a dark warm band that frames the bottom of the frame, with a single soft highlight along the flutes.

changes.problem: No sign of life: the listed props are not in frame and the zinc is bare apart from a white card and a blank placard.

evidence.measured: only a white menu card at left and a white placard (lum_median 178) at 590-630 x 340-370

change.from: glasses, candles and coat out of frame
change.to: a half-drunk coupe and a rocks glass on the zinc in the right foreground, one lit candle near frame centre-left, the coat over the nearest chair back, a record out of its sleeve on the deck; remove the blank white placard or turn it to read as a menu

changes.expected: Small warm highlights and reflections on the zinc; the frame reads as occupied at night.

changes.problem: The top of the frame is crushed, smeared mud, and the whole image has denoiser smear at proof scale.

change.to: full 2400 x 1600 at 1024 samples with the denoiser on albedo+normal prepass; exposure 0.75; haze 0.02 so that the Dome cones read faintly

changes.expected: Spines and timber grain resolve; the shadows hold detail without lifting the black.

changes.problem: The Dome liners are blown white discs that sit in front of the speakers and read as the hero instead of them.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 190 at the liner; it overlaps the left speaker's top

change.setting: EARF's lamps: each Dome liner glow / downlight
change.to: 20 W, glow 0.45; downlights 140 W, kept on the zinc

changes.expected: The pendants glow as warm accents, not white discs; the eye goes to the speakers.

out_of_scope.request: Change the electric-blue glow of the R3 Float's lit base to a warm or smoked tone
out_of_scope.why: The record player and its lit base are a fixed EARF product. As rendered, it is the single largest 'signage / nightclub' tell and the only saturated colour, and it competes with the speakers, so the owner should check whether blue is correct for the Smoke configuration.

out_of_scope.request: Move the Dome pendants so that they do not hang in front of the niches
out_of_scope.why: The layout is fixed; c2 (camera) is the in-scope way to separate them.
